press_references.value: Nuvocargo launches AI-native freight execution platform

product_launches.description: Nuvocargo launched Nuvo AI, an AI-native freight execution engine that helps shippers manage truckload freight across the U.S., Mexico, and Canada and tap into a network of over 300,000 carriers.

overview_description.description: Nuvocargo is the only all-in-one digital platform for cross-border trade offering freight forwarding, customs brokerage, cargo insurance and supply chain financing. It combines powerful technology with an exceptional team of experts to seamlessly integrate end-to-end movement of cargo in a single platform. Nuvocargo is modernizing a $2T market that has yet to experience real digitalization, empowering shippers with unparalleled visibility, efficiency and support. Run by a fully bi-lingual team, Nuvocargo's unique position at the intersection of technology, logistics, the US and Latin America, contributes to growing revenues >25% month over month since beginning operations in late 2019. Nuvocargo is backed by Tiger Global, QED Investors, NFX, ALLVP, world-renowned startup accelerator Y Combinator, leading entrepreneurs (including the founders of NuBank, Rappi, Loft, Ramp, Deel and the COO of Kavak) among others.

about_short_description.short_description: Nuvocargo is the all-in-one digital platform for cross-border trade between USA and Mexico.

product.name: Managed Transportation
product.description: AI-powered 4PL managed transportation service for North American shippers, coordinating freight planning, procurement, execution, tracking, payment, auditing, reporting, and continuous improvement.

product.name: Freight Brokerage
product.description: Freight brokerage for arranging over-the-road transportation between the United States and Mexico, with carrier sourcing, shipment pricing, border-focused visibility, and operational coordination.

product.name: Customs Brokerage
product.description: U.S.-Mexico customs brokerage that coordinates customs clearance, classification, duty and tax determination, regulatory compliance, documentation, and communication with customs authorities.

product.name: Carrier Services
product.description: A carrier-partner service providing recurring freight opportunities, digital shipment documents, load matching, operational support, compliance assistance, and accelerated payment options.

product.name: NuvoOS
product.description: Nuvocargo’s AI-powered transportation management technology for automating shipment creation, document processing, tracking, carrier matching, customs workflows, freight payment, audit, and operational reporting.
